steps.title: Read the topology table
steps.body: Type `enable`, then `show ip eigrp topology`. For 192.168.60.0/24, find the successor and the one feasible successor (its reported distance, the second number, must be below the FD). `submit SUCCESSOR=<next hop>` and `submit FS=<next hop>`.

steps.title: Work out a metric by hand
steps.body: Read `more flash:link-survey.txt` and calculate the metric for the pump house path with the EIGRP formula. `submit METRIC=<number>`.

steps.title: Put the spare to work
steps.body: In `conf t`: `router eigrp 100`, then `variance 2`. `end`, then `show ip route 192.168.60.0`: two paths, sharing traffic.

objectives.label: Saw both paths in the routing table
